source_signal: SME New Concept Proposal — no existing NCIt cell type for testicular NSGCT
rationale: A malignant germ cell that is a cellular component of a non-seminomatous germ cell neoplasm. NCIt 26.07d contains the broader Cell concept C54110 and disease/morphology concepts for non-seminomatous germ-cell neoplasia, but no Cell subtype expressing their intersection.
sme_notes: Corrected after source-bound duplicate review. File with NCI EVS only after germ-cell pathology review; the proposal remains unapproved.
